prompt:
Goal: Create a gritty cinematic poster-style infographic celebrating LEONARDO and his evolving film roles, titled like a prestige movie retrospective.

Canvas: Landscape 4:3 poster, dark sepia and charcoal palette, aged paper texture, smoky grunge background, subtle scratches, dust, blood spatters in the lower left, dramatic film-poster lighting, high-contrast realistic digital painting / photobash style.

Layout: Place a large realistic right-facing side-profile portrait of the actor on the center-right, occupying about one third of the width. On the left half, create a collage of exactly 12 smaller role portraits of the same actor at different ages and in different costumes, arranged in a loose pyramid around the large profile. The 12 visible role portraits are: 1 young clean-cut teen in a dark jacket, 2 aviator wearing leather flight helmet and goggles with shearling collar, 3 wet-haired romantic young man in scarf and coat, 4 slick-haired man in a black suit and tie, 5 bruised rugged man with blood and dirt on his face, 6 intense man shouting in a rain-soaked combat scene, 7 tuxedoed wealthy man holding a champagne flute, 8 exhausted fur-cloaked frontiersman, 9 drenched grim man with messy hair, 10 bearded man in a wide-brim hat, 11 stern modern man in a blue work jacket, 12 mustached man in a dark coat. Add exactly 2 prominent foreground props at bottom left: an antique pocket watch with chain and a hatchet/axe lying diagonally over a blood-stained surface.

Right-side typography and timeline: At the top right, set a huge distressed serif headline reading LEONARDO. Beneath it, centered small caps subtitle: A LIFE IN ROLES, with thin horizontal rules on both sides. Under the subtitle, create a vertical gold timeline with exactly 8 dot markers and text entries in condensed uppercase lettering: 1993 / THIS BOY'S LIFE / TOBY; 1997 / TITANIC / JACK DAWSON; 2002 / CATCH ME IF YOU CAN / FRANK ABAGNALE JR.; 2006 / THE DEPARTED / BILLY COSTIGAN; 2010 / INCEPTION / DOM COBB; 2013 / THE WOLF OF WALL STREET / JORDAN BELFORT; 2015 / THE REVENANT / HUGH GLASS; 2023 / KILLERS OF THE FLOWER MOON / ERNEST BURKHART. To the far right of the timeline, include exactly 4 era labels stacked vertically in gold: YOUTH / 1990s, ASCENT / 2000s, EXCESS / 2010s, SURVIVAL / 2020s.

Bottom text: Add a centered quote in uppercase with large quotation marks: HE DOESN'T JUST PLAY CHARACTERS. HE HOLDS UP A MIRROR TO THE CENTURY. Beneath the quote, place exactly 2 laurel award badges: left badge says ACADEMY / AWARD / WINNER, right badge says A CAREER / FOR THE AGES. Along the bottom edge, add spaced-out gold text reading SAME MAN. ENDLESS TRUTHS. with thin lines extending left and right, plus a small cursive signature beneath.

Visual style: Serious, epic, award-season promotional poster; realistic faces, weathered costumes, cinematic chiaroscuro, muted gold typography, distressed vintage serif fonts, condensed sans-serif timeline text, smoky vignette edges, no bright modern colors.

Constraints: Keep all text legible and in English, preserve the exact counts of 13 actor depictions total including the large profile plus 12 collage portraits, 8 timeline entries, 4 era labels, 2 foreground props, and 2 laurel badges. Do not add extra characters, logos, watermarks, or unrelated text.

promptZh:
目标：创作一张充满电影质感的写实海报风格信息图，旨在致敬 LEONARDO 及其不断演变的角色，标题采用大片回顾风格。

画布：横向 4:3 海报，深褐色与炭灰色调，做旧纸张纹理，烟雾缭绕的颓废背景，带有细微划痕、灰尘，左下角有血迹，戏剧性的电影海报灯光，高对比度写实数字绘画 / 照片合成风格。

布局：在右侧中心放置一张演员的大型写实右侧侧面肖像，占据约三分之一的宽度。在左半部分，围绕大型侧面肖像以松散的金字塔形状排列 12 张该演员在不同年龄和服装下的较小角色肖像。这 12 张可见的角色肖像为：1 位年轻干练的少年，身穿深色夹克；2 位戴着皮革飞行头盔、护目镜和羊羔毛领的飞行员；3 位湿发、围着围巾并穿着外套的浪漫青年；4 位梳着油头、身穿黑色西装打领带的男士；5 位满脸血迹和泥土、神情坚毅的粗犷男士；6 位在雨中战斗场景中大声咆哮的激烈男士；7 位身穿燕尾服、手持香槟杯的富有男士；8 位疲惫不堪、披着皮草的边疆开拓者；9 位浑身湿透、头发凌乱的冷峻男士；10 位戴着宽檐帽的蓄须男士；11 位身穿蓝色工作夹克的现代严厉男士；12 位穿着深色外套、留着胡须的男士。在左下角添加 2 个醒目的前景道具：一块带有链条的古董怀表，以及一把斜放在血迹斑斑表面上的斧头。

右侧排版与时间线：在右上角，设置一个巨大的做旧衬线字体标题，内容为 LEONARDO。下方居中放置小写大写字母副标题：A LIFE IN ROLES，两侧带有细横线。在副标题下方，创建一个垂直的金色时间线，包含 8 个圆点标记和压缩大写字母的文本条目：1993 / THIS BOY'S LIFE / TOBY；1997 / TITANIC / JACK DAWSON；2002 / CATCH ME IF YOU CAN / FRANK ABAGNALE JR.；2006 / THE DEPARTED / BILLY COSTIGAN；2010 / INCEPTION / DOM COBB；2013 / THE WOLF OF WALL STREET / JORDAN BELFORT；2015 / THE REVENANT / HUGH GLASS；2023 / KILLERS OF THE FLOWER MOON / ERNEST BURKHART。在时间线的最右侧，垂直堆叠 4 个金色时代标签：YOUTH / 1990s，ASCENT / 2000s，EXCESS / 2010s，SURVIVAL / 2020s。

底部文本：添加一句居中的大写引语，并配以大引号：HE DOESN'T JUST PLAY CHARACTERS. HE HOLDS UP A MIRROR TO THE CENTURY. 在引语下方，放置 2 个月桂奖章：左侧奖章写着 ACADEMY / AWARD / WINNER，右侧奖章写着 A CAREER / FOR THE AGES。沿底部边缘，添加间距拉开的金色文字 SAME MAN. ENDLESS TRUTHS.，两侧延伸出细线，下方附带一个小巧的草书签名。

视觉风格：严肃、史诗感、颁奖季宣传海报；写实面孔、风化服装、电影明暗对照法、静谧的金色排版、做旧复古衬线字体、压缩无衬线时间线文本、烟雾缭绕的晕影边缘，无明亮的现代色彩。

限制：保持所有文本清晰且为英文，保留总计 13 个演员形象（包括大型侧面肖像加 12 张拼贴肖像）、8 个时间线条目、4 个时代标签、2 个前景道具和 2 个月桂奖章的精确数量。请勿添加额外的字符、徽标、水印或无关文本。
